en: A sepia-toned image showing the ornate portal of a large Gothic church or cathedral. The entrance is richly decorated with statues of saints and arches layered in typical Gothic style. Two people, dressed in early 20th-century attire, stand at the base of the steps leading to the entrance. The postcard has a strong photographic, historical feel and no visible text other than the image itself.
